bearerAuth.description: Keycloak-issued access token. Two realms are accepted, the mobile realm and the admin realm; the token's issuer selects which. Endpoints under /admin additionally require the ADMIN role.

info.description:
REST API for the Yogida meditation platform. 
Provides presigned Cloudflare R2 streaming URLs and a catalog of available meditation media grouped by bucket.
info.title: Meditation Service API

post.description: Creates a new exercise. Send as multipart/form-data: part 'meta' (JSON, BreathingCreateRequest) + part 'iconFile' (required image). Audio files are added separately via POST /admin/breathing/phases/{phaseId}/audio.

One-off migration. Breathing phase audio was originally uploaded to the PUBLIC bucket and served by unsigned URL, so premium exercises were readable by anyone holding the link. New uploads now go to the private bucket; this moves the objects that predate that change and repoints their s3_object rows. Idempotent and safe to re-run. Run it with dryRun=true first — the delete of the public copy is not reversible.

parameters.description: Report what would move without changing anything. Defaults to true.
parameters.name: dryRun

post.summary: Move breathing phase audio into the private bucket

post.description: Uploads one audio file and links it to the specified phase. Multiple calls add multiple audio options; the mobile client picks one at random.
post.summary: Upload an audio file to a phase

parameters.description: S3 audio object ID to remove
parameters.name: audioObjectId

404.description: Phase or audio object not found

delete.summary: Remove an audio file from a phase

put.description: Bulk-updates the displayOrder of exercises. Send the full ordered list with new positions.

get.summary: Get a breathing exercise by ID

put.description: Partially updates the exercise. Send as multipart/form-data: part 'meta' (JSON, BreathingUpdateRequest) + optional part 'iconFile' (replaces current icon). If phases are provided they fully replace the current phase list.

get.description: Returns all media records regardless of status.

post.description: Uploads the file to S3 and creates the media catalog entry in one step.
post.summary: Create media record and upload S3 object

delete.description: Removes the DB record and deletes the associated S3 object. S3 deletion failure is logged but does not affect the response.
delete.summary: Delete media record and its S3 object

put.description: Updates metadata. If a new file is provided and the object key differs, uploads it to S3 and removes the old object.

delete.description: Bucket must be empty before deletion.

400.description: Invalid bucket name or bucket already exists

get.description: Reports three things: s3_object rows nothing references (each one permanently blocks its own key, because of the unique constraint on bucket/base_url/uri), object keys in a bucket with no row (wasted storage), and rows pointing at objects that are not there (a 404 at playback). Changes nothing — deleting storage on the strength of a query is how a bug turns into data loss.
get.summary: Reconcile s3_object rows against bucket contents

get.description: Returns all exercises ordered by displayOrder ascending.

get.summary: Get a breathing exercise by ID

get.description: Opens a per-user SSE stream. The authenticated user receives a push event whenever their RevenueCat entitlement changes (purchase, renewal, cancellation, expiration, etc.).

parameters.description: Stable per-app-instance connection id; reconnects with the same id replace the previous emitter instead of accumulating stale ones
parameters.name: X-Sse-Client-Id

post.description: Pushes a TEST event to all active connections of the calling administrator. A diagnostic for verifying that the SSE path survives the reverse proxy; it carries no entitlement meaning and is restricted to the ADMIN role.

get.description: Returns a list of all favourites.
Returns a single favourite by its ID.
Returns all media catalog entries with ACTIVE status.

post.description: Returns a time-limited presigned URL for streaming the media object.

example.message: Not entitled to access this media

403.description: User is not entitled to access this media

get.description: Returns a single media item by its database ID.

Returns the average rating, total rating count, and per-star breakdown (keys 1–5) for a media item.
All keys 1–5 are present in `starBreakdown` (missing stars have a count of 0).

put.description:
Creates or updates the review/rating row for the given user and media item.
`rating` updates the star rating (1–5) on every call.
`reviewText` is written on first save only; subsequent saves do not change it.

get.description:
Returns a paginated list of reviews for a media item.
Each entry may have a null `rating` (text-only review) or null `reviewText` (rating-only entry).
`userName` is derived from the user email prefix; `userInitial` is the first uppercase character.
Supported sort fields: `createdAt` (default, desc), `rating` (asc or desc).
Example: GET /media/1/reviews?page=0&size=10&sort=rating,desc
Returns a list of all user profiles.
Returns a single profile by its ID.

post.description: Administrative. Clients do not need this: signing in provisions the account.

get.description:
Returns the account belonging to the bearer token, creating it on first sight.
This is the only user endpoint a client application needs: identity comes from the
token, so nothing has to be looked up or supplied by the caller.
Administrative. Returns a single user matching the given email address.
Administrative. Returns a single user by their ID.

put.description: Administrative. Identity fields are ignored; they are not client-settable.

post.description: Authenticated by a shared secret in the Authorization header. Idempotent per event id.
